digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite — Jira Cloud S3 reconciler
propositions: A read-only, S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project test suite must be implemented to exercise the reconciler against real Cloud projects (REB, DIG) with real volume and diversity, covering the S3 store backend dimension that the Data Center harness cannot test.

The suite must enforce structural read-only invariants by monkeypatching all 18 mutating AcliClient methods to raise, and must verify via per-project Jira issue count assertions that no mutations occur before/after reconciliation.

The test store must use an isolated, throwaway S3 prefix (never production) as its only remote, with REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and the prefix must be deleted in teardown to ensure no production contamination.

The inbound fetch (compute_snapshot) and outbound preview (bridge_preview with Mode.DRY_RUN) must correctly scope to only real, reachable mapped projects (REB, DIG) and fail closed (raise) for unmapped/unknown project keys.

The suite must be gated by REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL and AWS credentials, integrated into CI as a separate jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal job, and excluded from the general external job to prevent double-collection.
